sections.heading: Publisher
sections.body: Sadikoi is published on a non-professional basis by Gabriel Garrone, under the missclick.net brand. Contact: gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Publication director
sections.body: Gabriel Garrone (gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com).

sections.heading: Hosting
sections.body: The service is hosted on servers operated for missclick.net (sadikoi.missclick.net).

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The Sadikoi name, interface and source materials are the property of their author. GIFs are provided by KLIPY and belong to their respective owners.

sections.heading: Reporting content
sections.body: Any unlawful or abusive content can be reported from the app ("Report" button on messages) or at gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com. It will be reviewed and removed promptly.

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: Gabriel Garrone, under the missclick.net brand. Contact: gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: Username, email address, password (stored hashed), profile picture, language, device name, and the content you create (groups, questions, votes, messages, GIFs). If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google name, email address and profile picture.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis
sections.body: To provide the service (authentication, group features, notifications, support and security), based on performance of the terms of use and our legitimate interest in securing the service. Notifications are only sent with your consent. We do not sell your data, show ads or profile users.

sections.heading: Third parties
sections.body: KLIPY (GIF search and display) receives your search terms and an internal user identifier. Google (Google Identity Services) handles Sign in with Google. PayPal processes donations, which are not handled by Sadikoi. Notifications go through your browser's or device's notification service.

sections.heading: Local storage
sections.body: The app uses your device's local storage (session, display preferences) only to function. No advertising or analytics trackers are used.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, it is deleted or anonymized, unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.heading: Minimum age
sections.body: Sadikoi is intended for people aged 13 or older. If you believe a child under 13 has created an account, contact us to have it deleted.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to, restrict and port your data. You can exercise them from the app or at gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in France, the CNIL: cnil.fr).

sections.heading: Account deletion
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from the app (Account, then "Delete account"), or by following the instructions on the /delete-account page.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.body: By using Sadikoi you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy.

sections.heading: Minimum age
sections.body: You must be at least 13 years old to create an account and use Sadikoi.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not post unlawful, hateful, sexually explicit, violent or harassing content, do not impersonate others, and do not attempt to disrupt the service.

sections.heading: Content and reporting
sections.body: You are responsible for the content you post. You can report inappropriate content from the app or at gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com. Content and accounts that violate these terms may be removed or suspended without notice.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for your account and for keeping your password secure. You can delete your account at any time from the app.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: The service is provided free of charge, as is, with no guarantee of availability. We are not liable for indirect damages arising from its use, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Donations
sections.body: Donations are optional, voluntary and give no entitlement to any compensation or feature.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. In case of a dispute, you can contact us to seek an amicable solution, then bring the matter before the competent courts.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: These terms may be updated; continued use means acceptance of the new version.

sections.heading: From the app
sections.body: Sign in, open the Account page, then tap "Delete account" and confirm. Deletion is immediate and irreversible.

sections.heading: Without access to the app
sections.body: Email gabrielgarronedev@gmail.com from the account's email address with "Account deletion" and your username. We will process your request within one month.

sections.heading: Data deleted
sections.body: Your account, profile information, devices and preferences are deleted. Content you posted in groups is deleted or anonymized.
